representativeSnapshot.kind: local Supabase target with an active organization member, intended invite recipient, and revoked/expired invite fixtures

rowCountQueries: Count pending, accepted, expired, and revoked public.org_invites by organization
Verify no public.org_invites.token values remain after the token_hash backfill
Inventory org_invites and org_members RLS policies before and after apply
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: One hash backfill per legacy invite token; no organization membership rows are changed during migration apply

execution.resumeStrategy: Reapply the idempotent migration in a local Supabase target; use a later additive migration for any production correction
execution.idempotency: Columns, schema, trigger, policies, and index use IF NOT EXISTS or explicit replacement; token hashing only updates rows missing token_hash

quarantine.strategy: Invites without a legacy token remain invalid instead of being guessed or backfilled from other identity data

constraints: Token hash uniqueness applies only to non-null hashes
Acceptance trigger keeps invite identity immutable and prevents acceptance after revocation or expiry
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify invite acceptance is atomic under concurrent replay, revoked/expired tokens fail, recipient email mismatch fails, and authenticated org owners/admins alone can revoke

recovery.rollback: Disable invite creation and acceptance routes; retain hashed tokens and use a corrective additive migration rather than restoring plaintext tokens
recovery.forwardFix: Add an additive policy or function correction and replay the local RLS fixture matrix before promotion

queries: Verify token is null and token_hash is populated for all migrated invites
Verify RLS is enabled and policy inventory includes recipient acceptance and invite-member insertion policies
Verify accept_org_invite and revoke_org_invite execute only for authenticated users
